FROM: CINCFLEET NORTHWOOD
TO: CTG 317.8
1 MAY 1982
Time Zone Used Throughout the Order: ZULU.

Argentine forces occupy the Falkland Islands and continue to strengthen the garrison by air. Diplomatic efforts have not secured their withdrawal. The carrier force is now in position east of the Islands and offensive operations may begin.
The Task Force is to commence airstrikes and bombardment of the Argentine position at Stanley to reduce its effectiveness and enable recapture of the Islands.

Task Force commander is to employ the carrier force against Stanley while retaining sufficient aircraft for fleet defence. RAF BLACK BUCK strikes from Ascension will hit the runway at Stanley early 1 MAY. Sea Harriers and the detached gun group are to attack the marked air-operations centre, maintenance stores, and aviation fuel installations. Suppression of Stanley air defence and the warning post on Sapper Hill is desirable. Argentine airstrikes from mainland are expected. Once strike objectives are complete, withdraw gun group ships to the east. Complete strike objectives by aircraft or ship gunfire as permitted by tactical situation.

Roland surface-to-air missile battery is emplaced at Stanley airfield and presents a high risk to Sea Harriers operating against the airfield complex. The battery is mobile, may remain silent until aircraft enter its engagement envelope, and is to be treated as the principal local air-defence threat. Radar-directed 35 mm guns cover the approaches. Mainland Mirage and Dagger formations may attack the detached gun group once the operation is detected. Intelligence reports that the Argentine trawler NARWAL is reporting our movements. Investigate fishing contacts near the force and engage positively identified enemy reconnaissance vessels if the tactical situation permits. Enemy submarine SAN LUIS is unaccounted for and may be near the islands as well.
Follow-on operations are expected and rearmament of ships is not expected for several days after this action. Conserve ordnance where possible.

J. D. E. FIELDHOUSE
Admiral, Commander-in-Chief Fleet
